tools.name: rtk
tools.purpose: CLI proxy that compresses command output to save tokens
tools.permissions: A PreToolUse hook (~/.claude/hooks/rtk-rewrite.sh) rewrites every Bash command Claude runs to go through rtk.

tools.name: jq
tools.purpose: JSON processor; used by the rtk hook

tools.name: gh
tools.purpose: GitHub CLI: pull requests for checkups, CI runs, repository information
tools.install: brew install gh && gh auth login
tools.permissions: Acts on GitHub as the logged-in owner, with the scopes granted at `gh auth login`.

tools.name: bun
tools.purpose: Runtime, package manager and test runner; runs the factory's scripts and hooks
tools.permissions: Runs the plugin's hook scripts at every session start.

tools.name: uv
tools.permissions: None beyond the commands it is asked to run.

tools.name: gopls
tools.purpose: Go language server; used by the gopls-lsp plugin
tools.permissions: Reads the Go code of the open project.

plugins.purpose: This software factory: conventions, checkups, model routing
plugins.permissions: SessionStart hooks run Bun scripts from its dist/ folder; skills; task agents.

plugins.purpose: Agent that simplifies recently changed code
plugins.permissions: One agent; no hooks, no MCP servers.
One skill; no hooks, no MCP servers.

plugins.purpose: Security warnings on edits and a security review of diffs and commits
plugins.permissions: Five hooks (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse, Stop, SubagentStop) that inspect edits and diffs.
Starts the gopls language server for Go projects.
